python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/apispec/ext/marshmallow/openapi.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('apispec.ext.marshmallow.openapi')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from apispec import APISpec
from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
from marshmallow import Schema,fields,validate
plugin=MarshmallowPlugin()
spec=APISpec(title='demo',version='1',openapi_version='3.0.3',plugins=[plugin])
converter=plugin.converter
class Item(Schema):
 z=fields.Integer(required=True,data_key='Zed')
 a=fields.String(required=True,data_key='Aye')
 optional=fields.String()
value=converter.fields2jsonschema(Item().fields)
print('fields_schema',value)
assert value['type']=='object' and set(value['properties'])=={'Zed','Aye','optional'}
assert value['required']==['Aye','Zed']
